ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (~5-8%) to low-intensity pixels (~92-95%) across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) base pigmentation with isolated high-intensity (white) geometric blobs appearing as small circular rosettes and thin linear streaks distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous localized circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black) scattered across the mid-to-distal regions of the right lobe and central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed primarily on the right lobe and central fluke area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular-textured protrusions (barnacle clusters) attached to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized pixel occlusion at the fluke base caused by high-intensity water spray and turbulence.
